title: 几何字母标志
template: Design a flat vector logo mark for {{subject}}. Build the mark from simple geometric primitives, use one accent color plus neutral tones, keep generous clear space, no gradients, no photorealism, centered on a square canvas.
note: 最通用的品牌标志写法，几何构图加单色点缀，模型不容易画脏。

title: 横版字标
template: Create a horizontal wordmark logo for {{subject}}. Place a compact abstract symbol on the left and the brand name in a geometric sans-serif on the right, single weight, tight letter spacing, one color, transparent background.
note: 横版字标适合导航栏，符号与文字的间距要在提示词里点明。

title: 徽章式标志
template: Draw a circular badge emblem logo for {{subject}}. Use a double ring border, a small central pictogram, and short curved text around the ring, flat two-color palette, symmetrical composition.
note: 徽章类要强调对称与环形文字，否则文字会飘出边界。

title: 抽象渐变标记
template: Produce a modern abstract logo mark for {{subject}}. Overlap two or three smooth organic shapes, apply a subtle two-stop linear gradient, keep the silhouette recognizable at 24px, no text.
note: 渐变标记要限两三个色标，色标多了导出会发灰。

title: 吉祥物标志
template: Illustrate a friendly flat mascot logo for {{subject}}. Simple rounded body, bold outline, two colors plus white, big expressive eyes, standing pose, no background clutter, suitable for a sticker.
note: 吉祥物标志关键是轮廓简洁，缩到小尺寸仍要认得出。

title: 负空间标志
template: Design a clever negative space logo for {{subject}}. Let the shape of the mark carve a second hidden symbol out of the background, two colors only, flat vector, generous margins.
note: 负空间标志靠留白暗示第二层含义，提示词要点明隐藏图形。

title: 24px 线性图标
template: Draw a single 24x24 line icon representing {{subject}}. Use a 2px stroke with round caps and joins, no fill, align to a 24 unit grid with 2 unit padding, pure monochrome.
note: 线性图标的规范写进提示词，产出可直接放进工具栏。

title: 64px 面性图标
template: Create a filled 64x64 app icon for {{subject}}. Use one solid silhouette, soft rounded corners, a subtle darker shade for depth, and a plain background shape, no text.
note: 面性图标靠剪影识别，别让模型加太多细节。

title: 双色图标
template: Design a duotone icon for {{subject}}. Split the shape into a primary solid area and a 40 percent opacity secondary area, 64x64 viewport, no strokes, flat and minimal.
note: 双色图标用透明度分层最稳，避免模型乱调色。

title: 四宫格图标组
template: Produce a 2x2 grid of four consistent line icons about {{subject}}. Keep identical stroke width and optical size, 8 unit padding inside each cell, monochrome, aligned to one grid.
note: 成组图标的一致性来自统一线宽与栅格，提示词里必须写死。

title: 状态徽标图标
template: Draw a small status badge icon for {{subject}}. Circular container, one glyph inside, a clear high-contrast color, 24x24 grid, no gradients, readable when scaled down.
note: 状态类图标要的是小尺寸可读，别追求细节。

title: 骑自行车的鹈鹕（经典基准）
template: A pelican riding a bicycle.
note: LLM 画图能力的老牌基准，用来快速验证模型是否真的输出 SVG。

title: 扁平场景插画
template: Create a flat vector illustration of {{subject}}. Compose three depth layers, use a limited five-color palette, no outlines, soft geometric shapes, and a clear focal point in the center.
note: 分层是扁平插画的关键，写清前景中景远景更好控制。

title: 等距视角插画
template: Illustrate {{subject}} in isometric projection. Use 30 degree axes, consistent block proportions, flat shading with three tones per face, and a plain background.
note: 等距插画靠 30 度轴和统一明暗，比例写清楚才不会歪。

title: 首屏横幅插画
template: Design a wide hero banner illustration about {{subject}}. Keep the left third visually calm for headline text, place the main subject on the right, use a smooth background gradient and flat vector shapes.
note: 首屏横幅要预留文字区，否则后期排版会被图压住。

title: 极简单线插画
template: Draw a minimal continuous line illustration of {{subject}}. Use one 3px stroke, a single color on a plain background, generous negative space, no shading, no fill.
note: 单线风格靠留白，提示词里限定笔画数更稳。

title: 横向流程示意图
template: Create a clean left-to-right flow diagram explaining {{subject}}. Use rounded rectangles for steps, arrows between them, a muted palette, sans-serif labels at 16px, and a light background.
note: 流程图要把方向、节点形状、字号都写明，模型才不乱放文字。

title: 分层架构图
template: Draw a layered architecture diagram for {{subject}}. Stack three horizontal bands, put labeled boxes inside each band, connect related boxes with orthogonal lines, use one accent color for emphasis.
note: 架构图的横平竖直很重要，正交连线比曲线更好读。

title: 时间轴
template: Generate a horizontal timeline diagram about {{subject}}. Draw one baseline with evenly spaced milestones, alternate labels above and below, use dots and thin connectors, keep typography small and tidy.
note: 时间轴节点数要写死，不然模型会挤出一堆重叠标签。

title: 维恩图
template: Create a two-circle Venn diagram comparing {{subject}}. Use translucent fills with clear overlap, centered labels in each region, thin outlines, and a short caption below.
note: 维恩图用半透明填充才能看清交集区域。

title: 组织结构图
template: Draw an org chart for {{subject}}. Place one root node at the top, three children below connected by orthogonal elbows, identical rounded boxes, even spacing, monochrome with one accent header.
note: 组织图的关键是等距对齐，提示词里给出层数与分支数。

title: 仪表盘线框稿
template: Produce a wireframe-style dashboard mockup for {{subject}}. Include a top bar, a left sidebar, three stat cards and one large chart area, gray placeholder blocks, a single accent color, 8px spacing grid.
note: 线框稿比高保真稿稳定，重点在栅格与占位块。

title: 移动端登录页
template: Design a mobile login screen mockup for {{subject}}. Phone frame at 9:16, logo at the top, two input fields, one primary button, one text link, plenty of vertical rhythm, flat colors.
note: 移动稿先定外框比例，再排元素，模型才不会把内容压扁。

title: 落地页首屏
template: Create a landing page hero section mockup for {{subject}}. Headline on the left, product visual on the right, a primary call-to-action button, a slim navigation bar on top, soft neutral background.
note: 首屏稿的价值在信息层级，标题、按钮、图三者的权重写明。

title: 设置面板
template: Draw a settings panel mockup for {{subject}}. Group options into labeled sections, use toggles and dropdowns as simple shapes, align everything to a 8px grid, one accent color, light theme.
note: 设置面板靠分组标题和控件形状区分，别让模型自由发挥。

title: 数据表格页
template: Produce a data table screen mockup for {{subject}}. Include a header row with five columns, eight body rows with placeholder text bars, zebra striping, a pagination footer, and a filter bar above.
note: 表格要写清行列数，否则行高会失控。

title: 柱状对比图
template: Generate a bar chart visualizing {{subject}}. Draw axes with ticks, five bars with value labels above them, a subtle grid, a legend, and a 20px bold title. Use a restrained two-color palette.
note: 图表可读性靠刻度、数值标签和图例三件套。

title: 折线趋势图
template: Create a line chart showing the trend of {{subject}}. Plot two series with distinct colors, add markers at each point, a light area fill under the primary series, labeled axes and a small legend.
note: 折线图要限定数据点数量，点太密标签会叠在一起。

title: 环形占比图
template: Draw a donut chart breaking down {{subject}} into four parts. Use distinct flat colors, a small gap between segments, percentage labels outside the ring, and a centered total number.
note: 环形图分段不要超过五段，否则颜色和标签都会挤。

title: 仪表盘刻度
template: Create a semicircular gauge chart for {{subject}}. Draw a 180 degree arc with a colored progress portion, tick marks every 10 percent, a large centered value, and a short caption below.
note: 仪表盘用半圆最稳，整圆容易和环形图混淆。

title: 热力矩阵图
template: Produce a heatmap grid visualizing {{subject}}. Use a 7x5 matrix of rounded squares, one hue with varying opacity, row and column labels in 12px, and a compact legend strip on the right.
note: 热力图用单色透明度表达强度，比多色渐变更清晰。

title: 扁平角色头像
template: Illustrate a flat vector character portrait of {{subject}} in a half-body composition. Use bold simple shapes, a limited palette, no outline heavier than 3px, friendly proportions, and a plain circular background.
note: 角色类要限定构图范围，否则模型会堆满全身细节。

title: 贴纸吉祥物
template: Draw a sticker-style mascot of {{subject}}. Thick white outline around the whole figure, exaggerated expression, simple three-color palette, dynamic pose, no background.
note: 贴纸风格靠粗白描边和夸张表情，背景一律不要。

title: Q 版小人
template: Create a chibi character illustration of {{subject}}. Two-head-tall proportions, oversized head, tiny limbs, clean flat shading, one soft shadow under the feet, plain background.
note: Q 版必须写死头身比，不然比例会崩。

title: 机器人助手
template: Illustrate a friendly helper robot character themed around {{subject}}. Rounded chassis, single glowing visor, articulated arms, flat vector shading, front-facing pose, neutral background.
note: 机器人角色用圆角外壳加单一面罩最容易出好图。

title: 风格化胸像
template: Create a stylized vector bust portrait representing {{subject}}. Geometric facial planes, limited four-color palette, strong silhouette, no photographic texture, centered composition.
note: 风格化人像用几何切面替代写实细节，避免五官糊成一团。

title: 无缝几何纹样
template: Create a seamless repeating geometric pattern inspired by {{subject}}. Make the edges match exactly when tiled, use three flat colors, keep shapes evenly spaced, and fill the whole canvas.
note: 无缝纹样必须强调边缘对齐，否则拼接会露缝。

title: 波浪分隔装饰
template: Draw a decorative wave divider motif themed around {{subject}}. Repeat three smooth curves across a wide strip, single color on transparent background, consistent amplitude, no text.
note: 分隔装饰用于版面过渡，宽度比例要适配横幅。

title: 对称曼陀罗
template: Create a radially symmetric mandala ornament inspired by {{subject}}. Repeat one petal motif eight times around a center, use two stroke weights, monochrome line art, perfectly balanced composition.
note: 曼陀罗靠八重对称，提示词里给出重复次数很关键。

title: 装饰边框
template: Design a decorative rectangular frame border themed around {{subject}}. Repeat a small corner ornament at all four corners, thin double rule along the edges, centered empty area inside, monochrome.
note: 边框要留出中心空白，方便后期放内容。

title: 点阵背景
template: Generate a subtle dot grid background texture related to {{subject}}. Evenly spaced small circles, low contrast two-tone palette, seamless at the edges, no focal element, flat vector.
note: 背景纹理要低对比，否则会抢正文的注意力。
